Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Isha - 12 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Neeta - 40 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Savitri - 63 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Riya - 11 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Neeta, Isha and Savitri stand near him.]

Isha: "What lovely weather!"

[Rishabh bursts out laughing.]

Isha (surprised): "That was fun!"

[Rishabh smiles at Mother.]

Rishabh: "That's easy."

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Isha, Neeta and Savitri stand near him.]

Isha: "Mom, look over here."

[Rishabh does push-ups.]

Neeta: "What next?"

[Rishabh does yoga on a mat.]

Savitri (laughing): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Isha skips rope.]

Rishabh (happily): "What next?"

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

[Rishabh is asleep in bed in the bedroom. Neeta and Riya stand near him.]

Rishabh: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh wakes up and rubs his eyes.]

Rishabh: "That was such a fun day!"
